subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should accepted non-transient gateway disconnects land now as fresh-session embedded fallback, or should this PR wait for the reattach-first design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: The patch fixes same-session transcript duplication, but it intentionally preserves the product tradeoff where the accepted gateway run and local fallback may both execute.

options.title: Land focused fresh-session mitigation
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for this rare disconnect path and keep reattach-first as a separate product follow-up.

options.title: Fold in reattach-first before merge
options.body: Ask the contributor to extend this PR so the CLI waits for the accepted gateway run before falling back to a fresh embedded session.

options.title: Pause for owner decision
options.body: Hold the PR until the gateway/session owner decides the disconnect recovery policy across interactive and `--deliver` modes.

recommendation.title: Land focused fresh-session mitigation
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for this rare disconnect path and keep reattach-first as a separate product follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor has the most recent and repeated history on the CLI gateway dispatch and session fallback files touched by the PR.
